title: 부모님과 선생님 이야기하기: 할머니께서 오세요
objective: By the end, you can use 께서 or 께서는 instead of 이/가 or 은/는 for a person you respect, and match it with a verb ending in -(으)세요.
summary: Learn the honorific subject particle 께서 so you can talk politely about parents, grandparents, teachers, and bosses.

task.title: USE 께서 CORRECTLY
task.line: Read each item and choose, fill in, check, or write the correct Korean.

forms.when: Use it in place of 이/가 when the subject is someone you respect (grandparents, parents, teachers, bosses). It is the same after a vowel or a consonant: 어머니께서, 선생님께서.
forms.exampleMeaning: My grandmother is at home. (계세요 is the honorific form of 있어요.)

forms.when: Use it in place of 은/는: to introduce or talk about a respected person as the topic.
forms.exampleMeaning: My father is an office worker.

forms.when: When you use 께서, the verb must also be honorific: add -(으)시-. After a stem ending in a vowel: 가세요. After a stem ending in a consonant: 읽으세요. If the stem ends in ㄹ, drop ㄹ and add -세요: 살다 → 사세요.
forms.means: The particle and the verb both show respect.
forms.exampleMeaning: The teacher is reading a book.

watchOut: 선생님이께서 (X) → 선생님께서 (O): 께서 replaces 이/가. Do not use both together.
할머니께서 와요 (X) → 할머니께서 오세요 (O): with 께서, the verb also needs -(으)시-.
저께서 (X) → 제가 (O): never use 께서 for yourself.
친구께서 (X) → 친구가 (O): use 께서 only for older or higher people, not for friends or younger people.
exercises: Choose the right word: ①사장님께서 사무실에 (있어요 / 계세요). / ②선생님(께서 / 이께서) 한국 노래를 부르세요.
Write 께서 or 이/가. Use 께서 only when the verb has -(으)시-: ①우리 어머니____ 은행에서 일하세요. / ②제 동생____ 학교에 가요. / ③제____ 커피를 마셔요.
Write O if the sentence is correct and X if it is wrong: ①저께서 한국어를 공부해요. / ②선생님께서 이름을 쓰세요. / ③친구께서 학교에 와요. / ④할머니께서는 텔레비전을 보세요.
Correct the verb so it matches 께서: 할아버지께서 공원에서 운동해요.
Rewrite the sentence with 께서는: 할머니는 중국 사람이에요.
Answer in Korean with 께서, using the word in brackets: 할아버지께서 어디에 가세요? (병원)
answers: ① 께서 ② 이 ③ 가 (제가)
① X (제가 한국어를 공부해요.) ② O ③ X (친구가 학교에 와요.) ④ O
